major_frozen_architectural_decisions: SQLite is the Ledger Foundation V1 system of record at schema version 1.
analysis_cutoff_at is the authoritative inclusive analysis boundary.
run_request_id, attempt_id, and run_id identify distinct entities and namespaces.
Artifacts identify immutable bytes; InputObservations separately record source and temporal availability semantics.
Temporal availability propagates through acyclic derivation_node and derivation_edge graphs.
RETRIEVED_AT_FALLBACK is required when trustworthy source publication time is unavailable.
execution_eligible_at is derived and materialized under an immutable versioned policy.
FIXED_HORIZON and TRADE_LIFECYCLE are separate outcome families.
The corrected lifecycle is monotonic, has no TP1_HIT-to-OPEN transition, and includes EXPIRED_UNFILLED and INVALIDATED_UNFILLED.
Research-to-setup lineage is explicit and all content-influencing research is required provenance.
Failed-attempt artifacts remain durable audit evidence even though failed attempts create no run.
Challenge Cases and the Experiment Registry are versioned, durable Ledger records.
Legacy data is explicitly classified and gated by point-in-time quality.
semantic_change_rule: Any semantic change after this freeze requires a new specification version.
